notes.title: Version 1.5, improved support for games
notes.notes:
Version 1.5 brings following changes:
* added screenshot manager (requires Special Edition)
* added support for launch parameters with '/' character
* added "widescreen-fix" tweak
* added "widescreen-fix" field for tweaks
* added "config-value-float" tweak:
[i]    - used by Widescreen Fixes Pack configs[/i]
* added support for // comment after value in "Key = Value" / "INI" configs:
[i]    - used by Widescreen Fixes Pack configs[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36538279/8da93b8eefc9d882bcceac443c33199b4d77f35d.png[/img]

At the moment screenshot manager will move PNG screenshots into nicely names subdirectories.
Let us know if you would like to convert PNG screenshots into JPG.
With some size estimation, so they will have better quality than default JPG screenshots,
but will take less space than PNG screenshots.

Thanks to above changes support for existing games has been improved:
* Max Payne 1:
[i]    - added Widescreen Fix installer tweak and "Override FOV" tweak[/i]
* Max Payne 2:
[i]    - added Widescreen Fix installer tweak and "Override FOV" tweak[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36538279/a95a1842bebcdc08cf69cc16fc57c9e261827866.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.4, improved support for games
notes.notes:
Version 1.4 brings following changes:
* launch parameters are now injected when game is started with "Launch game" button
* added "config-raw" tweak
* added "config-raw-value" tweak
* added "registry-string" tweak
* "registry" and "registry-value" tweaks support NULL default value:
    - just like "registry-string" tweak
* added support for JSON config
* Notepad++ is now launched for XML configs when "Edit config" button is clicked:
    - Notepad++ must be installed in default directory
* Notepad++ is now launched for configs with non-Windows line endings when "Edit config" button is clicked:
    - Notepad++ must be installed in default directory

Thanks to above changes support for existing games has been improved:
* Aliens versus Predator Classic 2000:
    - converted "Enable quick save / quick load" hint to tweak (config-raw tweak)
    - converted "Enable crouch toggle" hint to tweak (config-raw tweak)
* Alpha Protocol:
    - converted "Override FOV" hint to tweak (config-raw-value tweak)
* Batman: Arkham Asylum:
    - converted "Override FOV" hint to tweak (config-raw-value tweak)
* Batman: Arkham City:
    - converted "Override FOV" hint to tweak (config-raw-value tweak)
    - added "Change mouse sensitivity" tweak
* Batman: Arkham Origins
    - converted "Change mouse sensitivity" hint to tweak
* BioShock 1:
    - converted "Override FOV" hint to tweak (config-raw-value tweak)
* BioShock 2:
    - converted "Override FOV" hint to tweak (config-raw-value tweak)
* Dead Effect 2:
    - converted FOV and anisotropic filtering hints to tweaks (JSON config)
* Hitman 2: Silent Assassin:
    - converted "Disable startup videos" hint to tweak (config-raw tweak)
* Mass Effect 1:
    - converted "Override FOV" hint to tweak (config-raw-value tweak)
* Remember Me:
    - converted "Override FOV" hint to tweak (config-raw-value tweak)
* Star Wars: The Force Unleashed 1:
    - converted Polish / Russian language hints to tweaks (registry-string tweaks)
* Star Wars: The Force Unleashed 2:
    - converted English language hint to tweak (registry-string tweak)
* UberSolider 2:
    - added "Enable console" tweak (config-raw tweak)

notes.title: The Force is Strong in this update
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We hope you are doing well :)

Here are details about new version 1.3: [list]
[*] added second EXE that runs without administrator rights:
    - [i]should fix "Unable to initialize Steam" error[/i]
[*] added integration with LUA scripting language:
    - [i]used to transform values between UI and config for value tweaks[/i]
[*] Edit config button opens menu when there are multiple configs
[*] Notepad++ is now launched for XML configs when "Edit config" button is clicked:
    - [i]Notepad++ must be installed in default directory[/i]
[*] improved processing of Quake 3 Engine configs
[*] comments in XML configs are now retained
[*] added "transform-function" field for "config-value" and "registry-value" tweaks
[*] added new point in Important information dialog about possibility to add more games
[/list]

Now when program is started Steam will give you option to run two executables.
Default which is recommended and non-admin which should be run only
when there is problem with Steam initialization.

Also support for games improved: [list]
[*] added support for following games:
    - Alien: Isolation
    - Mirror's Edge
    - Star Wars: Battlefront 1 (2004)
    - Star Wars: Battlefront 2 (2005)
    - Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic 1
    - Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic 2
    - Star Wars: Republic Commando
    - Star Wars: The Force Unleashed 2
    - Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy
    - Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Outcast
[*] necessary transformation of FOV values is now performed (thanks to LUA) for following games:
    - Firewatch
    - Metro Exodus
    - Thief (2014)
    - TimeShift
[*] corrected toggle windowed mode combination for a couple of games
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36538279/aa2b7130e846ff54d05b890af4bbfd256fc34e89.png[/img]

Program will now transform FOV via LUA script for some games.
For example FOV for Firewatch is stored in very unconventional way,
and quite complex calculations are needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36538279/bdb4958f4e5d33eac02993d51c5f5224a1c7adba.png[/img]

Now you can just enter FOV you want and it will be converted :)

Take care and stay safe!

Regards,
GameAssistant Team

notes.title: Version 1.2, more games and prices reduction
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We hope you are doing well :)

It took some time, but here is new version!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36538279/4c498abb9a174b24196f08b66f19a30e18790f1b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36538279/35139f46a5ebea073df76359f9f137191b5c124e.png[/img]

Version 1.2 brings following features:
- dark theme
- possibility to launch and kill unsupported games
- new "authors" field in config (author names presented in UI)
- support for Chaser game config

Please note that dark theme requires Special Edition.
Don't worry, all essential features will be always available in standard edition.

Also support for 15 new games was added:
- Bet on Soldier
- BloodRayne 1
- BloodRayne 2
- Chaser
- Gothic 3
- Mafia 1
- Mafia 2
- Risen 1
- Risen 2: Dark Waters
- Risen 3: Titan Lords
- Sniper: Ghost Warrior 1
- Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2
- Sniper: Ghost Warrior 3
- Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Vegas 1
- Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Vegas 2

Links to walkthroughs for Dead Island Definitive editions
now point to updated games and not old releases.
This issue was reported by [i]skrifty[/i].

Prices for program and Special Edition DLC will be reduced:
- from 9,99 USD to 5,99 USD
- from 5,99 USD to 4,99 USD
This tool might be useful especially now, when you have more time to play games.
But we understand that you have more important expenses in these hard times.

Thank you for being with us!

Take care and stay safe!

Regards,
GameAssistant Team

notes.title: It's here, finally (version 1.1)!
notes.notes:
It's here, finally (version 1.1)!

Today is [b]the day[/b]! Program is available for everyone :)

You will download version 1.1, which was prepared in cooperation
with [b]Achievement Hunting[/b]: https://achievementhunting.com.

It brings options that allow to hide some tweaks for games with achievements:
* patches and mods
* gameplay changes
* other changes incompatible with Achievement Hunting rules
Also cheats for all games can be hidden, if you are not interested.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36538279/819de7363612832a1105c83e952d63987660b5b4.png[/img]

"Spread the word and get 3 keys!" offer is still available:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1190750/discussions/6/1743389952522555589

Also check out Special Edition DLC. For now it brings support for multiple Steam accounts,
but more features will be available in the future.
It's also a great way to support us :)

Regards,
GameAssistant Team
